findings.detail: Non-loopback publication requires both shipped block-style OTLP protocol TLS stanzas; unsupported layout fails remote check. Certificate validity and actual runtime handshakes remain untested here.
envget approximates Compose env syntax; empty exported values, interpolation and quoting may differ. Runtime gate/Compose validation remains necessary.

Token format preliminary check allows short/multiple nonempty entries, while shipped strict authenticator rejects them; disk headroom uses project filesystem rather than actual Docker volume filesystem; Docker availability/version messages are not engine readiness proof.

findings.detail: Final claim limited to ingress checks; gRPC optional and queue gauge visibility warning-only; no destination/privacy readback.

TLS detection still infers common protocol mode from any TLS stanza; custom CA paths with spaces and curl config escaping of quote/backslash tokens are not handled robustly. Probes have no explicit timeout; ingress HTTP200 response body is not inspected for partial success.
